In an Archenemy game, these methods aren’t used to determine who takes the first turn.
A player still in the game wins the game if that player’s opponents have all left the game. This happens immediately and overrides all effects that would preclude that player from winning the game.
If an effect states that a player wins the game, all of that player’s opponents within that player’s range of influence lose the game instead.
